verdict.rationale: Featurebase markets a hosted feedback portal with public roadmap, voting, and branded standalone pages (docs-15, docs-19, docs-9/17), which are core SaaS features implying self-service setup by a PM. However, there is no explicit documentation of a no-code portal builder/admin UI or confirmation that no engineering/dev work (e.g., DNS, embed code) is needed to launch it. missing for 10: explicit no-code setup walkthrough/admin UI screenshots, confirmation that custom domain/branding requires zero engineering involvement.
